steps.note: Create the trigger function that keeps amount and total equal on every insert/update, whichever one the writer set.
steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orders_sync_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN IF NEW.total IS NULL THEN NEW.total := NEW.amount; ELSIF NEW.amount IS NULL THEN NEW.amount := NEW.total; END IF; ELSE IF NEW.amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount AND NEW.total IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.total THEN NEW.total := NEW.amount; ELSIF NEW.total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total AND NEW.amount IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount THEN NEW.amount := NEW.total; END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $f$;

steps.note: Expand: add the nullable total column (metadata only) and the sync trigger in one transaction, so no new row is missed. 200ms lock_timeout, retried, so a waiting ALTER never stalls app queries for long.
steps.sql: DO $do$ BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); FOR i IN 1..300 LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN total numeric(10,2); CREATE TRIGGER orders_sync_total BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION orders_sync_total(); RETURN; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(0.3); END; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'could not get the lock on orders'; END $do$;

steps.note: Add CHECK (total IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID: metadata only, brief lock with retries.
steps.sql: DO $do$ BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); FOR i IN 1..300 LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null CHECK (total IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID; RETURN; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(0.3); END; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'could not get the lock on orders'; END $do$;

steps.note: Validate the check: a full scan under SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, which does not block app reads or writes. Fails (and stops the plan) if any total is still NULL.
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null;

steps.note: SET NOT NULL on total (no table scan: the validated check already proves it), then drop the helper check. Brief lock with retries.
steps.sql: DO $do$ BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); FOR i IN 1..300 LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN total SET NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null; RETURN; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(0.3); END; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'could not get the lock on orders'; END $do$;

steps.note: Switch the app to read and write total. While old and new pods overlap, the trigger fills total from amount (old pods) and amount from total (new pods), so both versions keep working.
Give terminating old pods time to finish in-flight requests before amount goes away.
Contract: drop the trigger and the amount column (both metadata only) in one transaction with a brief lock and retries, then drop the function.
steps.sql: DO $do$ BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); FOR i IN 1..300 LOOP BEGIN DROP TRIGGER orders_sync_total ON orders; ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN amount; RETURN; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN PERFORM pg_sleep(0.3); END; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'could not get the lock on orders'; END $do$; DROP FUNCTION orders_sync_total();
